lines.en: label rikaspring1:
scene nightsky
It’s Saturday night and I’m ready to party.
lines.zh: : 周六夜,派对走起。

lines.en: Just kidding. I hate myself and I’m ready to die.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。我恨我自己,我准备好了赴死。

lines.en: But it is Saturday night, and that means something to most people. So I will stand here in the middle of the sidewalk and wait for someone to drag me into whatever they’re doing right now.
lines.zh: : 但它确实是周六夜,而这对大多数人来说有意义。所以我会站在人行道中央,等某个把我拖进他们当下活动的人出现。

lines.en: : I’m bored.
lines.zh: : 我好无聊。

lines.en: Upon voicing my boredom, my phone immediately begins to ring, proving once more that there probably is a god out there watching over me and toying with my every emotion.
lines.zh: : 我一说出口,手机立刻响了——再次证明:天上多半真有个神在看着我、玩弄我的每一种情绪。

lines.en: Now please excuse me as I continue to ignore it in favor of whoever’s on the other end of the phone.
lines.zh: : 现在,请原谅我继续无视那个神,去理电话那头的人。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Yo! Happy Saturday. Are you ready to party?
lines.zh: : 哟!周六快乐。准备好派对了没?

lines.en: : You know it, Rika.
lines.zh: : 你懂的,Rika。

lines.en: : Okay, never mind then. I needed help with something.
lines.zh: : 好,那算了。我本来需要人帮忙。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well...I’m ready for that too, I guess. What do you need help with?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那个我也准备好了,我猜。你需要什么帮助?

lines.en: : I’m officially moving into my new place today and need some extra hands. Imani’s coming too. So I’ll buy you guys pizza or beer since the Internet said that’s how I’m supposed to pay friends who help me.
lines.zh: : 我今天正式搬进新住处,需要多几双手。Imani 也来。我会请你们披萨或啤酒——网上说,帮朋友搬家就该这样付酬。

lines.en: : I could have sworn you already had a place of your own. Have you really been with Rin this entire time?
lines.zh: : 我记得你明明早就有自己的住处了。你一直住在 Rin 那里?

lines.en: : I’ve been moving around. Long story. But this place should be cool! I think. I hope. Maybe. Anyway! Are you in or out? Speak now or I will forever hold this pizza.
lines.zh: : 我一直辗转搬家。说来话长。但这地方应该很酷!我觉得。我希望。大概吧。总之!你来还是不来?现在开口,否则这块披萨我将永远为你保留。

lines.en: : I’m in. Just send me the address.
lines.zh: : 我来。把地址发我就行。

lines.en: : Oh, shit. I forgot to get the address. Let me call you back!
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了。我忘了拿地址。我回你电话!

lines.en: : Just text it to me, Rika.
lines.zh: : 发短信给我不就行了,Rika。

lines.en: : No can do, bud! The government is watching. They read every single one of our texts.
lines.zh: : 办不到,伙计!政府在监视。我们的每一条短信它们都读。

lines.en: : Anyway, BRB. I have to text the landlord my kojin bangō so they know I’m legit and can send me the address. But then I’ll call you back! Promise!
lines.zh: : 总之,马上回来。我得先把我的个人编号发给房东,证明我是正经租客,他们才肯发地址。然后我打给你!保证!

lines.en: : You still there?
lines.zh: : 你还在吗?

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Well, stop! Do some stretches or something! And start heading over! Bye!
lines.zh: : 那别干了!做做拉伸什么的!然后出发!拜!

lines.en: scene black
Rika hangs up the phone and I am once again very worried about how she is ever supposed to survive on her own.
lines.zh: Rika 挂断电话,我再一次深深担忧:她一个人要怎么活下去。

lines.en: At least when she was rooming with Rin, she had her to rein her in and...probably teach her how to do laundry and whatnot. But now, I fear that person is going to wind up being me.
lines.zh: : 至少她和 Rin 同住的时候,还有人管着她……顺便教她洗衣服什么的。而现在,我害怕那个人最后会变成我。

lines.en: And that’s very worrying since I only kind of know how to do laundry. Or anything really.
lines.zh: : 这非常令人担忧,因为我自己也只是勉强会洗衣服。或者勉强会做任何事。

lines.en: Oh well. I’ll just hope that she finds another girlfriend soon. Or that all of my school-friends adopt polyamory so she can just join the Wakana/Osako relationship.
lines.zh: : 算了。我就盼着她早点交上新女友。或者我所有校友都开放多元成家,让她直接加入 Wakana/Osako 的关系里。

lines.en: And hey, if those two are still struggling, maybe Rika can be the missing link that binds their chain back together?
lines.zh: : 而且嘿,要是那两位还在磨合,说不定 Rika 正是能把她们的链条重新接上的缺失一环?

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace1
Or maybe that would make life way too convenient for everyone involved and only serve to tear down the barrier between all of them and my penis. So hey, a man can dream.
lines.zh: : 又或者,那会让所有相关者的生活方便过头,只会拆掉她们与我的 penis 之间的屏障。嘿,人总是可以做梦的。

lines.en: And a man can also help move stuff around in exchange for pizza and beer, so excuse me as I graduate to a level past “confused adolescent boy in a grown man’s body” for an hour or two.
lines.zh: : 而人也可以帮忙搬东西换取披萨和啤酒——所以请原谅我,接下来一两个小时,我将从「成年男人身体里的迷茫青春期少年」毕业升级。

lines.en: : Hey! Thanks for showing up. I decided to keep Imani outside so the two of you could see how awesome and cool my new apartment is at the same time.
lines.zh: : 嗨!谢谢你们来。我特意让 Imani 待在外面,这样你们俩可以同时见证我的新公寓有多 awesome 多酷。

lines.en: : Hey, Senpai! Were you able to find the place okay?
lines.zh: : 嗨,学姐!地方好找吗?

lines.en: : Yeah. Really easily, actually.
lines.zh: : 嗯。说真的,非常好找。

lines.en: : Oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗?

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace2
: Was it because my apartment is literally right there?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 难道是因为我的公寓就在你眼前?!?!?!

lines.en: : You know, I thought this place looked familiar.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我就说这地方看着眼熟。

lines.en: : What’s the problem, Imani? Now we can stay up all night and talk about when we were young. You can even teach me how to do laundry!
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗,Imani?这样我们可以通宵不睡,聊聊「我们年轻时」。你还可以教我洗衣服!

lines.en: : Don’t remind me that I’m not young anymore! I am very sensitive when it comes to that subject!
lines.zh: : 别提醒我我已经不年轻了!这个话题我超敏感!

lines.en: : Then why are you going around making out with people in their forties?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么跑去和四十多岁的人亲热?

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace3
: That was one time.
lines.zh: : 那只有一次。

lines.en: : And a totally forgettable one at that! So yeah, now it’ll be easier for you to find me. Which you’ve never attempted to do before. But now you can! If you want. Which you probably don’t.
lines.zh: : 而且是完全可以遗忘的一次!总之,现在你要找我更容易了。虽然你从来没找过。但现在可以了!如果你愿意的话。你多半不愿意。

lines.en: : I’m already over here a decent amount since Imani’s two doors down and the girl in the room next to yours is another one of my friends.
lines.zh: : 我本来就常来这边——Imani 隔两个门,你隔壁房间的女孩也是我朋友之一。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace4

: You’re friends with the cool biker bartender lady? What’s her name? I forgot. Is she a lesbian? Because my gay-dar didn’t ring at all, but I’m getting conflicting vibes from all the leather and denim.
lines.zh: : 你认识那个超酷的机车女酒保?她叫什么来着?我忘了。她是蕾丝边吗?我的 gay-dar 完全没响,但她那一身皮衣和牛仔布,信号很矛盾。

lines.en: : You’ve lived here for three minutes and you’re already planning on hooking up with your neighbor?
lines.zh: : 你搬来才三分钟,就已经在计划勾搭邻居了?

lines.en: : You know what they say, Imani. If the shoe fits, go fuck a girl.
lines.zh: : 俗话说得好,Imani。鞋合脚,就去睡个女孩。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace5
: Since when do they say that?...
lines.zh: : 什么时候有过这种俗话?……

lines.en: : Yuki is, to my knowledge, very straight. But you’ve turned women before, so maybe you can work your magic on her as well.
lines.zh: : 据我所知,Yuki 是直得很彻底的。但你转化过女人,说不定你也能对她施展魔法。

lines.en: : Do you know her age? Is she older than me?
lines.zh: : 你知道她多大吗?比我大吗?

lines.en: : Late thirties, I believe.
lines.zh: : 快四十了吧,我记得。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace6
: Damn, really? Could’ve fooled me. She looks way older than Rika.
lines.zh: : 搞什么,真的?完全看不出来。她看起来比 Rika 老多了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but Rika also looks way too young for her age and Yuki had a drug problem for a while. I’m sure that plays some role in her appearance.
lines.zh: : 是,不过 Rika 的长相也比实际年龄嫩太多,而 Yuki 有过一段药物问题时期。我确信这对她的容貌有影响。

lines.en: : I’m starting to worry that I’m the oldest woman in Kumon-mi...No one is ever going to love me again and Rin is going to have to find a third mom when the garbage men accidentally collect my body.
lines.zh: : 我开始担心,我是 Kumon-mi 最老的女人了……再也不会有人爱我了,而等收垃圾的不小心把我收走,Rin 就得去找第三个妈妈了。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace7
: Oh well, though. If all else fails, I guess there’s you. I can subject myself to a life of 6/10 makeout sessions if you’re above average when it comes to hand stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过算了。如果一切都失败,我想还有你。只要你「手活」在平均水准之上,我可以忍受一种 6/10 分接吻的人生。

lines.en: : Rika, this better be a fuckin’ damn good pizza.
lines.zh: : Rika,这顿披萨最好他妈的非常非常好吃。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace8
: Fuck! I forgot the pizza!
lines.zh: : 糟了!我忘了买披萨!

lines.en: scene black
: Weren’t you literally holding it when you called me?
lines.zh: : 你打电话的时候不是手里拿着吗?

lines.en: : I must have dropped it somewhere! Why does this keep happening to me every time I buy a pizza?!
lines.zh: : 我一定是掉在哪儿了!为什么每次买披萨都会发生这种事?!

lines.en: : This has happened more than once?!?
lines.zh: : 这发生过不止一次?!?

lines.en: : Oh! You know what, maybe I left it inside before you guys got here. There’s only one way to find out! Onward, gang!
lines.zh: : 哦!等等,说不定在你们来之前我落在屋里了。验证方法只有一个!出发,伙伴们!

lines.en: Rika pushes her way through the door and pridefully marches to the center of a room that looks a lot like Imani’s and Yuki’s.
lines.zh: Rika 推门而入,骄傲地走向房间正中央——那房间看起来和 Imani、Yuki 的几乎一模一样。

lines.en: Just...with one glaring difference.
lines.zh: 只是……有一个刺眼的差别。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace9
: Isn’t it just beautiful?! I bet Rie’s shaking in her boots now. Rika’s back on the market and back out in the world!
lines.zh: : 难道不美吗?!我打赌 Rie 现在吓尿了。Rika 重回市场、重返世界!

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace10
: Wait, when did Rie get boots? Rie never wore boots. Are they mine? Do they still fit?
lines.zh: : 等等,Rie 什么时候有靴子了?Rie 从来不穿靴子。是我的吗?还合脚吗?

lines.en: : Rika, question. What the fuck is going on in here?
lines.zh: : Rika,问个问题。这屋里到底是什么鬼情况?

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace11
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 咦?什么意思?

lines.en: : I think she’s talking about how the place is completely empty. Both Imani and Yuki’s places came furnished.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她是在说:这里完全空空如也。Imani 和 Yuki 的住处都是带家具的。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m not sure if I’d say completely empty.
lines.zh: : 呃,我不确定能不能说「完全空空如也」。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace12
: There’s certainly...some stuff in it.
lines.zh: : 这里肯定……有一些东西。

lines.en: : Yeah, I feel like this might be one of those cases where less would actually be more.
lines.zh: : 对,我感觉这属于那种「少即是多」的案例。

lines.en: : It’s a work in progress, sure! But I got a hefty discount after the last couple in here was murdered. They wouldn’t let me keep any of their stuff, though. Dumb rule.
lines.zh: : 当然,一切都在进行中!而且上一对住在这里的情侣被杀之后,我拿到了超大折扣。不过他们不让我保留任何遗物。蠢规定。

lines.en: : You actually wanted it?
lines.zh: : 你其实还想要?

lines.en: : You really think I’m in the position to turn down a free couch, Imani? Plus, those girls had a damn Macbook. A Macbook! I’ve always wanted to read one of those.
lines.zh: : Imani,你觉得我有资格拒绝一张免费的沙发吗?再说,那些女孩有一台该死的 Macbook。一台 Macbook!我一直想读一本那个。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace13
: Does she think a Macbook is an actual-
lines.zh: : 她是不是以为 Macbook 是——

lines.en: : Would it really surprise you if she did? Rika, this is an active crime scene. You can’t live here.
lines.zh: : 她真这样想,你会惊讶吗?Rika,这里是一个活跃的犯罪现场。你不能住这。

lines.en: : There’s also a rat eating an entire cheese wheel on the ground.
lines.zh: : 地上还有一只老鼠,正在啃一整轮奶酪。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I gave him that. He’s my son now. And soon, he’ll be off to rat college where he’ll live in his little rat dorm and-
lines.zh: : 哦,对。那是我给的。他现在是我儿子了。很快他就要去老鼠上大学,住进他的小老鼠宿舍,然后——

lines.en: : Rats live for like three years max.
lines.zh: : 老鼠寿命最多三年左右。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace14
: Nooooo! My son!
lines.zh: : 不要————!我儿子!

lines.en: : I’m never going to get another minute of peace in this apartment complex again, am I?
lines.zh: : 我感觉这个公寓楼,从此再也别想有一分钟的安宁了,对吧?

lines.en: : Rika, why are we even here?
lines.zh: : Rika,我们到底为什么来这里?

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace15
: You really think I’m the person you should be asking that question to? I only just learned where the ropes are a couple months ago. Give me a break, man.
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得该问我这个问题吗?我几个月前才刚知道绳子在哪。放过我吧,伙计。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace16
: No, Rika. He’s obviously talking about how you called us over here for the sole purpose of helping you move. But you have nothing to move.
lines.zh: : 不,Rika。他明显在说:你叫我们过来唯一的目的是帮你搬家,而你的家当是零。

lines.en: : Technically, I never said I needed help moving — just that I needed extra hands.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,我从没说需要人「搬家」——我只说需要多几双手。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace17
: Which I do for all the high fives I should be getting! Put her there, homie!
lines.zh: : 我确实需要——为了那些我理应收到的高五!来,击个掌,homie!

lines.en: : Rika-
lines.zh: : Rika——

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace18
scene rikasnewplace19
: Don’t encourage her! She just wasted hours worth of time that we could have spent having sex with each other!
lines.zh: : 别惯着她!她刚刚浪费了我们几个小时,那几个小时本来可以用来互相做点什么!

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace20
: Yeah, except for the part where you guys don’t even have sex. Remember how I almost paid the taco guy to bone you? That like literally just happened.
lines.zh: : 是啊,除了你们俩根本「没有做」的那个部分。记得我差点付钱让墨西哥卷饼小哥来干你吗?那真的就是刚才的事。

lines.en: : Taco guy? You mean Taco Man? The one who works in the subway?
lines.zh: : 卷饼小哥?你是说 Taco Man?在地铁里干活那个?

lines.en: : Probably. He sell tacos?
lines.zh: : 大概。他卖卷饼吗?

lines.en: : I’m not sure he knows how to do anything else.
lines.zh: : 我不确定他还会干别的什么。

lines.en: : Yeah well you might be right because he didn’t seem all that excited about boning Imani either. Maybe she’s just cursed.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你可能是对的,因为他被要求干 Imani 时也不太兴奋的样子。也许她是被诅咒了。

lines.en: : Rika, you are right. We haven’t had sex.
lines.zh: : Rika,你说得对。我们还没有做过。

lines.en: : Duuuuuh. If that happened, you guys-
lines.zh: : 废————话。要是做了,你们俩——

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace21
: But Senpai may have eaten me out for over three hours in one sitting. So sex is clearly the next step.
lines.zh: : 但学姐可能一口气给我口了三个多小时。所以做爱显然是下一步。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace22
: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!??!?!!
: You look...way too happy about this.
lines.zh: : 你看起来……对这件事高兴得过头了。

lines.en: : Are you sure it’s okay to just come out and tell her like that?
lines.zh: : 你确定直接这样告诉她没问题吗?

lines.en: : Okay?! Why would it not be okay?! This is the greatest news I’ve ever heard in my life!
lines.zh: : 有什么问题?!这是我这辈子听过 greatest 的消息!

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace23
: Two of my best friends engaging in a healthy session of consensual cunnilingus for three whole hours?! KYAAAAAH!
lines.zh: : 我两个最好的朋友,进行了一场健康、自愿、长达三个小时的互舔?!呀啊啊!

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace24
: Wait. It was consensual, right? She didn’t just force you down there?
lines.zh: : 等等。是自愿的,对吧?她没有强行把你按下去?

lines.en: : It was consensual, yes.
lines.zh: : 是自愿的,没错。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace23
: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!!!!!!
: Bruh.
lines.zh: : 服了。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace25
: Hey, you can’t blame me for thinking you might have gone a little stir crazy the moment you saw him. A decade-long dry spell could kill a girl. I start feeling faint after like one month.
lines.zh: : 嘿,你不能怪我——你一见到他,我当然担心你立刻疯了。十年空窗能要了一个女孩的命。我一个月就开始头晕了。

lines.en: : But it’s been way longer than a month since you’ve broken up with Rie hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可你和 Rie 分手,早就超过一个月了吧?

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace26
: Yes.
scene rikasnewplace27
scene rikasnewplace28
scene rikasnewplace29
: If you fuck Rika before me...I swear to God, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢在我之前睡 Rika……我对天发誓,学姐。

lines.en: : Well, considering that we now have an entire night to not help Rika move-
lines.zh: : 好吧,考虑到我们现在有一整个晚上「不用帮 Rika 搬家」——

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace30
: Hell no, we don’t! The hands part might be over after the singular high five I received, but now we’ve gotta celebrate the two of you finally tying the labial knot!
lines.zh: : 想得美,才没有!「手」的部分可能在我收到唯一一个高五之后就结束了,但现在我们要庆祝你们俩终于系上了小阴唇结!

lines.en: : Can you please never call it that again?
lines.zh: : 你能不能永远别再用那种叫法?

lines.en: : Fine. Then we’ve gotta celebrate how this nonstop game of “will they, won’t they” has turned into a completed game of “they will!”
lines.zh: : 行。那我们就庆祝,这场没完没了的「他们到底会不会」游戏,终于变成了已通关的「他们会!」

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace31
: I’m like, super happy for you guys. No joke. You deserve nothing but happiness and multiple orgasms every night for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 我是说,真心为你们高兴。不掺假。你们值得幸福,以及余生每晚多次高潮,别的什么都不配。

lines.en: : Well...thanks, Rika. I...we really appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢,Rika。我……我们真的很感激。

lines.en: : But it’s not like we have to celebrate it. Let’s just...head over to a furniture shop and try to find you...a futon or something so you don’t have to crash at my place again.
lines.zh: : 不过也不用特意庆祝。我们不如……去家具店,给你找一张…… futon(蒲团)什么的,这样你就不用再来我家打地铺了。

lines.en: : This late at night? Nothing’s going to be open.
lines.zh: : 这么晚?什么店都不会开门。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace32
: Yeah, but I can’t go back to your place either if you’re about to invite me since you’re Imani’s crush and probably my daughter’s too.
lines.zh: : 也是,但如果你要邀请我去你家,我也不能去——你是 Imani 的暗恋对象,多半也是我女儿的那种对象。

lines.en: : I’m not inviting you to my place. I’m agreeing that we should go out and celebrate. Even...if it feels kind of strange to throw a party over me putting my mouth on Imani’s vagina.
lines.zh: : 我没邀请你去我家。我是同意我们该出去庆祝。虽然……为我「把嘴放上 Imani 的阴道」这件事开派对,感觉是有点奇怪。

lines.en: : Low key, Wakana and I already threw a mini-party about that. But that party was pretty much just the two of us getting shit-faced and binging all of Wednesday on Netflix. Her choice, obviously.
lines.zh: : 小声说,那场迷你派对 Wakana 和我早就办过了。不过那场派对基本就是我们俩喝到断片、在网飞上刷完整季《西部世界》。她的选择,显然。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace33
: Then it’s definitely my turn! And it will give me the excuse to use some of the money I saved from this apartment on repaying you guys! Everyone wins!
lines.zh: : 那这次绝对轮到我了!而且这给了我一个理由,用搬家的省下来的钱回报你们!全赢!

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace34
: Except the Yamazaki family. God rest their souls.
lines.zh: : 除了山崎一家。愿他们的灵魂安息。

lines.en: scene rikasnewplace35
: Okay! Resting done! Let’s go get drunk and talk about all the sex you two are gonna have from now on!
lines.zh: : 好!休息完毕!走吧,喝到断片,顺便聊聊你们俩今后要做的所有爱!

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...fiiiiine. But I swear, if you bail before we get the check, I will find you. I know where you live now.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧————。但我发誓,你要是敢在买单之前跑掉,我会找到你的。我现在知道你住哪了。

lines.en: : Have I ever done that before?
lines.zh: : 我以前那样过吗?

lines.en: : Yes. Several times.
lines.zh: : 有。好几次。

lines.en: : Wait, really? Also, can I crash at your place again tonight? Because the alternative is Sensei’s place and you saw the way we looked at each other a couple minutes ago. There’s tension there.
lines.zh: : 等等,真的?另外,我今晚还能再赖你家吗?因为另一个选项是 Sensei 家——而你看到了几分钟前我们俩对视的样子。那里有张力。

lines.en: : Yeah, I noticed and I hate it! So yes, you can sleep at my place! And you are now banned from making eye contact with Senpai for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 我注意到了,而且我恨它!所以行,你可以睡我家!并且从现在起到今晚结束,禁止你和学姐对视。

lines.en: : But his eyes are so pretty! Look! Look at ‘em!
lines.zh: : 可他的眼睛好漂亮!看!你看嘛!

lines.en: Rika grabs my face and aims it at Imani while pushing the two of us outdoors.
lines.zh: Rika 抓住我的脸对准 Imani,同时把我们俩推出门外。

lines.en: But just as we turn the corner to head over to our regular dive bar, Rika proclaims that she wants something more special tonight.
lines.zh: : 而就在我们拐过街角、要去我们常去的破酒吧时,Rika 宣布今晚她想要更特别一点的地方。

lines.en: My suggestion of a love hotel is promptly denied by both of them (which is honestly surprising, but whatever) so I suggest another bar instead.
lines.zh: : 我提议的情人旅馆被她们俩果断否决(说实话挺意外,但无所谓),于是我又提议了另一家酒吧。

lines.en: And seeing as I only know one other bar, you can probably guess where we’re headed...
lines.zh: : 鉴于我只认识另一家酒吧,你们大概能猜到我们的目的地……
